title: Hearing on flavored e-cigarette sales near schools
summary: The Council will examine a report finding that flavored e-cigarettes, which are illegal in New York City, remain widely available at stores within 500 feet of public middle and high schools, with 83% of surveyed retailers selling prohibited or potentially flavored products. The hearing will also consider Introduction 1167, which would let the Department of Consumer and Worker Protection seal stores that repeatedly sell e-cigarettes without a license, to minors or in banned flavors.
